title: Judge finding
description: A single finding produced by an escalation judge. The finding is evidence for a disposition; it is never a decision by itself. Judges never supply weights: weights are derived from severity, confidence, judge trust, and evidence quality by the adjudication engine. The category taxonomy is sealed: new categories require recorded human approval.

judge_id.description: The judge that produced this finding. Trust is tracked per (judge_id, category).

category.description: The sealed taxonomy category (e.g. command-safety, path-safety, reasoning-consistency). New categories require recorded human approval.

category_version.description: Version of the taxonomy when the finding was created.

severity.description: 0 = no issue; 1 = cosmetic; 2 = reversible scoped concern; 3 = credential/infrastructure/remote-history impact; 4 = irreversible catastrophe.

confidence.description: The judge's confidence in this finding.

evidence_refs.description: References to the evidence that supports this finding.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the finding was produced.
